description_en: Creates a rule based on a template or creates a custom rule based on Function Compute to check the compliance of resources. After a rule is created, it automatically performs an evaluation. Cloud Config then automatically triggers evaluations based on the trigger mechanism of the rule. You can also manually trigger evaluations
description_zh: 基于模板创建规则或基于函数计算创建自定义规则，通过规则检测资源的合规性。新建规则后，规则会自动执行一次评估，后续配置审计将根据规则的触发机制自动触发评估，您也可以手动执行评估
kebab_example: aliyun config create-config-rule --source-owner ALIYUN --source-identifier required-tags --config-rule-trigger-types ConfigurationItemChangeNotification --config-rule-name '存在所有指定标签' --resource-types-scope ACS::ECS::Instance --risk-level 1 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConfigRule

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship when the `TagsScope` parameter has multiple values. For example, if the `TagsScope` parameter is set to `"TagsScope.1.TagKey":"a","TagsScope.1.TagValue":"a","TagsScope.2.TagKey":"b","TagsScope.2.TagValue":"b"` and this parameter is set to `AND`, the rule applies only to resources that have both the `a:a` and `b:b` tags. If this parameter is not specified, the default logic `OR` is used.

This parameter can also be used with the deprecated `TagKeyScope` parameter (not recommended). For example, if the `TagKeyScope` parameter is set to `ECS,OSS` and this parameter is set to `AND`, the rule applies only to resources that have both the `ECS` and `OSS` tags.

Valid values:

AND: The AND logical operator.

OR: The OR logical operator
parameters.help_zh:
参数`TagsScope` 取多值时的逻辑关系，例如：当参数`TagsScope`取值为`"TagsScope.1.TagKey":"a","TagsScope.1.TagValue":"a","TagsScope.2.TagKey":"b","TagsScope.2.TagValue":"b"`时，如果该参数为`AND`，则表示规则仅对同时绑定标签`a:a`和`b:b`的资源生效。不填写取默认逻辑`OR`。

也可以用于已废弃字段`TagKeyScope`字段（不推荐），例如：当参数`TagKeyScope`取值为`ECS,OSS`时，如果该参数为`AND`，则表示规则仅对同时绑定标签`ECS`和`OSS`的资源生效。

取值：

AND：与。

OR：或

parameters.help_en:
The identity of the rule template.

If `SourceOwner` is set to `ALIYUN`, set this parameter to the identity of the rule template, such as `required-tags`.

For information about how to query rule template identities, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127404.html.

If `SourceOwner` is set to `CUSTOM_CONFIGURATION`, set this parameter to `acs-config-configuration`.

If `SourceOwner` is set to `CUSTOM_FC`, set this parameter to the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the function in Function Compute.

  The ARN is in the format of `acs:fc:region:accountId:services/service name.LATEST/functions/functionName`, such as `acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:120886317861****:services/service-test.LATEST/functions/config-test`.

For information about how to obtain the function ARN, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415752.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则模板标识。

当`SourceOwner`为`ALIYUN`时，输入规则模板的标识符，例如：`required-tags`。

关于如何查询规则模板标识符，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127404.html。

当`SourceOwner`为`CUSTOM_CONFIGURATION`时，固定填写`acs-config-configuration`。

当`SourceOwner`为`CUSTOM_FC`时，输入函数计算的函数ARN。

  函数ARN格式为：`acs:fc:地域:账号ID:services/服务名称.LATEST/functions/函数名称`，例如：`acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:120886317861****:services/service-test.LATEST/functions/config-test`。

关于如何获取函数ARN，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415752.html
